title: tests/stubs/claude wait_sh and dead-before-sh for closeout drivers
body:
**Chose:** extend `tests/stubs/claude` so build/fix/polish dead outcomes still run plan `sh` before exiting, and checkpoint/polish workers honor `wait_sh` barriers in the new driver tests
**Over:** rewiring every stub consumer or in-test process mocks
**Because:** slice-04 tests need deterministic barriers and lane files surviving a dead first attempt without a broader stub redesign
**Undo:** revert the stub branches touched for polish/ci-fix respawn and land-lane conflict sections
**Review:** fyi
